name: Limeboom Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce
author: Limeboom

sections.description:
Limeboom Product Video Gallery lets you show a product video inside the WooCommerce gallery — the natural place customers already look.

How it works: you pick a video URL and a poster image per product. The poster is written into the product’s real gallery data, right after the featured image, so it shows up in any theme — including themes with fully custom gallery sliders. A play button appears on the poster; clicking it swaps the image for an HTML5 video player, inline.

Free features:

  • Unlimited products with video
  • Direct video file URLs (MP4, WebM, OGG, MOV — format detected automatically)
  • Click-to-play with a clean play button overlay
  • Poster becomes a genuine gallery item — theme-independent by design
  • Autoplay, muted, loop, and controls settings
  • Adjustable play button overlay sizes
  • Opt-in clean uninstall

Need more? Limeboom Product Video Gallery Pro adds:

  • YouTube and Vimeo URL support
  • Play on hover and autoplay-on-scroll (muted) triggers
  • Multiple videos per product
  • Video play analytics on your Products list
  • Schema.org VideoObject markup for video rich results in search
  • Priority support
sections.installation:
1. Install through the WordPress plugin screen, or upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  3. Edit a product, open Product data → General, enable the product video, paste a video URL, and choose a poster image.
  4. Update the product. The poster appears as the second image in the gallery with a play button.
  5. Optional: adjust playback behavior under WooCommerce → Product Video Gallery.
sections.faq:
Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Instead of hooking into theme-specific gallery rendering, the poster image is written into the product’s actual gallery data — the same field every theme reads from. Tested with Storefront, Astra, and Flatsome, including themes with custom gallery sliders.

Which video formats are supported?

Direct file URLs: MP4, M4V, WebM, OGG/OGV, and MOV. The correct MIME type is detected from the file extension. YouTube and Vimeo URLs are supported in the Pro version.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Nothing, by default. Your video URLs and poster selections are kept, so reinstalling (or upgrading to Pro) picks them right back up. If you want a clean removal, enable “Remove all plugin data” in the settings before deleting.

Where does the video poster appear?

Right after the product’s featured image — the second image customers see in the gallery.
